The [roadmap](../../roadmap.json) at the cited revision records all nine M0 features as
`done` (`pipsystem`, `dcfd90671a25fd048162aead88e4674d3ec90e10:roadmap.json:5-18`).
These pages cover eight design decisions and their integration into the design.
The numbers come from the [October 7 integration matrix](../../.cg-docs/plans/2026-10-07-m0-m1-design-integration.md)
(`c439cdbbeeb0042b8d8b0ceb636c974363067d65:.cg-docs/plans/2026-10-07-m0-m1-design-integration.md:156-169`).
The checks compare documents; they do not establish runtime behavior.
